name: Electricity-Compute Arb Securitization Desk v0
description: Agentic desk that identifies dislocations in the electricity-compute spread (S_t = compute$/GPU-hr − k × electricity$/MWh × kWh/GPU-hr) and routes positions across four surfaces: crypto, hyperscaler equities (IBKR demo paper), predictive markets on AI/compute companies (Polymarket read + scorer gate), and direct energy events. Each position wraps as one ERC-8183 job on Arc Testnet with the judge layer as evaluator; ERC-8004 reputation accrues per resolved position.
code_path: agent/arb_identifier.py (S_t z-score), agent/surface_router.py (routing), agent/judge.py (4-way classifier), agent/scorer_bridge.py (upstream premium gate at api/polymarket/longtail/scorer.py:47)
